Dear [Mr Craik](/person/379)
Here is [the Reputed Changeling](/book/205).

It really is a much better story than [Beechcroft at Rockstone](/book/201) which was chiefly written to run on with the [Monthly Packet](/periodical/52) and satisfy people insatiable of continuations, so that as a young people’s tale it suffers from being treated as a novel.

Has it gone to [Tauchnitz](/person/2124)?

What a curious book Reuben Sachs is!

Is [Amy Levy](/person/2381) a genuine Jew- ?[^1]
She seems to have stripped off all the illusions, not to say realities! about the race

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: Amy Levy, Reuben Sachs: A Sketch (London, Macmillan 1888), a novel about upper middle-class Jewish life in London.
